rules.when: The task depends on fresh news, current events, live public facts, or recent market and product changes.
rules.why: Grok is the preferred dispatch when current web-connected context is central to the work.

rules.when: The task is routine implementation, a bounded mechanical edit, or a low-ambiguity fix.
rules.why: Fast implementation profile; Fixer remains implementation-only.

rules.when: The task involves authentication, authorization, security, concurrency, data integrity, or a high-blast-radius refactor.
rules.why: Stronger implementation profile for elevated risk; keep implementation with Fixer.

rules.when: The task is an independent correctness or architecture review before validation.
rules.why: Independent deep reviewer profile; Oracle is read-only.

rules.when: The task is a post-PR release-risk review.
rules.why: Lelouch is read-only and limited to release risk after a PR exists.
